scripts.build:mac: pnpm tauri build --bundles app && hdiutil create -volname 'FastShare' -srcfolder src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/FastShare.app -ov -format UDZO src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/FastShare.dmg
scripts.build:android: KEYSTORE_FILE="$HOME/keystore/fastshare.keystore" KEY_ALIAS=fastshare ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" JAVA_HOME="$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(which java))))" pnpm tauri android build
scripts.build:android:debug: ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" JAVA_HOME="$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(which java))))" pnpm tauri android build --debug
